name: Sa-Ra Enerji Insaat Ticaret Ve Sanayi A.S.
summary: Sa-Ra Enerji Insaat Ticaret Ve Sanayi A.S. provides design, engineering, and contracting services for power transmission lines, transformer station projects, distribution networks, and telecommunications projects. The company offers manufacturing services, including energy transmission line towers, energy transmission line hardware, steel structures, fasteners, silicone insulators, and galvanization; and turnkey projects, such as energy transmission lines, switch units, LW/MW urban distribution networks, and guardrail projects.
